printf 'DISPLAY=%s WAYLAND_DISPLAY=%s XDG_SESSION_TYPE=%s\n' "${DISPLAY:-}" "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" "${XDG_SESSION_TYPE:-}"
loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
for p in list(range(9220,9241))+[8788,9515]:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{p}/json/version', timeout=.2) as r:
            x=json.load(r)
        print('CDP_VERSION',p,json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True))

        pass
